note: Nieuwmarkt/Lastage (wijk AF) district look, centrum-looks round 2 (2026-11-16): the belt look's donor method over AF01-AF09. Only 16 D1 reads stand in the wijk, so the belt's kept reads are the main donors at a small foreign cost (0.3): its grachten (Kloveniersburgwal, Oudeschans, Geldersekade, Groenburgwal, Recht Boomssloot, Zwanenburgwal) are the belt's 17th-18th-century canal-house stock. Pitch band: the belt's (too few own reads to measure). maxYear 1914 as in the Jordaan (the 1970s-80s metro-line renewal and later blocks stay with today). Roof signals and the house-by-house brick draw as in the Jordaan.

wallDraw.note: Wall colour by judgement (David 2026-11-14), centrum-looks round 2: the district brick drawn house by house (wallDraw.ts). Period weights are a judgement of the Jordaan street fronts (taken over unchanged for Nieuwmarkt/Lastage), not a measurement: 17th-18th-century fronts mostly red-brown and brown brick with some orange-red; the 1860-1914 rebuilds brown, red-brown and orange-red machine brick with some yellow buff. Dark purple-brown and dark grey are never drawn either (the round-1 fault was too dark): they stand only where a read, a sample against its neighbours or the register says so. Paint is never drawn: a wrongly painted front reads louder than a wrong brick (round-2 sheet: Rozengracht 168914 drew cream against the photo's red-orange brick); painted and stucco fronts stay where a read or the register states them.
